Victoria, British Columbia, is accessible by air and sea, with several convenient transportation options for visitors travelling to the University of Victoria.

Victoria International Airport (YYJ) is approximately 30 minutes from the University of Victoria. Flying directly into Victoria is generally more convenient and economical than flying into Vancouver or Seattle, unless travelling from or planning to visit those cities.

To get from the airport to the city center, you can take a taxi. The fare is approximately $70-$80. Seaplane service is also available from Vancouver (Harbour Air) and Seattle (Kenmore Air) to Victoria Inner Harbour.
Visitors travelling from Vancouver can take BC Ferries from Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay, located approximately 40 minutes from downtown Victoria. Ferries accommodate both vehicles and foot passengers.

For those travelling without a vehicle, BC Ferries Connector offers coach transportation between downtown Vancouver (including Vancouver Airport) and downtown Victoria, in both directions. The journey involves taking the ferry from the mainland (Tsawwassen) to Swartz Bay on Vancouver Island. The coach will drop you off in downtown Victoria, and the same applies for the return trip.

Passenger ferry services are also available between downtown Seattle and Victoria's Inner Harbour. Before making your travel plans, ensure your passport is valid and check whether you require an eTA (Electronic Travel Authorization) or other necessary documentation.

section.h2: How to get from the city centre to the University of Victoria
section.p: The University of Victoria is located approximately 9 km from downtown Victoria and is accessible by public transit, taxi, or bicycle.

BC Transit provides regular bus service between downtown Victoria and the university. Routes 11, 14, and 15 connect downtown Victoria to the UVic campus (Choose, in order of preference, route 15 (Express), 14, or 11 (route 11 is the most scenic, but the slowest). A single adult fare is $3, and a day pass is $6. You can pay with cash or using the Umo app. For more information, including transit maps, destinations, boarding points, and transfer policies, please visit the BC Transit website.
